*For my study abroad Marine Biology field course in teh Fall 2025, I went through the entire research process, where in groups we developed a research question and project outline studying Giant Clam ecology in Heron Island. Our group analyzed the differences in size and abundance across a disturbed (near by the island harbor) and undisturbed site on the island.*
